# MineDraft figures

Figures 1 and 2 from **MineDraft: A Framework for Batch Parallel Speculative Decoding**,
by Zhenwei Tang, Arun Verma, Zijian Zhou, Zhaoxuan Wu, Alok Prakash, Daniela Rus,
and Bryan Kian Hsiang Low.

Source: [arXiv:2603.18016v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18016v3), September 1, 2026.
License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/),
as listed on the paper's arXiv page. Retrieved October 31, 2026.

| Local file | Original asset |
|---|---|
| [figure-1.svg](figure-1.svg) | [Pipeline.svg](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.18016v3/Pipeline.svg) |
| [figure-2.svg](figure-2.svg) | [MineDraft.svg](https://arxiv.org/html/2603.18016v3/MineDraft.svg) |

The SVG files are byte-for-byte copies, renamed locally. The short explanations
in the [MineDraft design note](../../MineDraft.md) are ours; the figures have not been edited.
